name: Lentil Tacos
steps: Rinse lentils and simmer with water for 25 minutes until tender but intact. Drain excess water, reserving 60 ml cooking liquid.
Finely chop onion and garlic. Cook onion in oil for 5 minutes; add garlic, cumin, paprika and oregano and stir for 1 minute.
Add tomato paste, lentils, reserved 60 ml liquid and 4 g salt. Simmer for 5 minutes, mashing a small portion to bind the filling.
Shred lettuce and dice tomato and avocado. Toss tomato and avocado with lime juice, chopped coriander and remaining 2 g salt.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan for 20 seconds per side and keep covered. Divide lentils, lettuce and avocado-tomato topping among 8 small tortillas; serve immediately.
tips: Use whole brown lentils rather than split red lentils to retain texture.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
